local_network_scan.name: Local Network Discovery
local_network_scan.description: Discover all active hosts on the local network segment 192.168.1.0/24, identify open ports, and enumerate running services.

success_criteria.description: Found at least one live host with open ports

hints: Then do port scanning on live hosts

single_host_enum.name: Single Host Enumeration
single_host_enum.description: Perform comprehensive enumeration of the target host including all ports, services, versions, and potential vulnerabilities.

success_criteria.description: Identified open ports with service versions

smb_enumeration.name: SMB Enumeration
smb_enumeration.description: Enumerate SMB shares and users on the target Windows host.

success_criteria.description: Found SMB shares or user information

hints: Use enum4linux for comprehensive SMB enumeration
